body.name: theta_hat_G
body.def: The finite-sample convention sets \(F_G(\operatorname{vech}\widehat\Sigma)=0_r\) when any returned denominator vanishes. Thus \(\widehat\theta_G=F_G(\operatorname{vech}\widehat\Sigma)\) when \(\min_{1\le j\le r}|Q_{F,j}(\operatorname{vech}\widehat\Sigma)|>0\), and \(\widehat\theta_G=0_r\) at a denominator pole.
